title: The Swarm
offer: My bees swarmed! A whole cloud of them flew off with a young queen, and Solveig says they hang in her apple tree. Bring them this empty hive, and bring them back to me.

steps.say: They hang there like a big brown pear! Hold the hive under them... shake... they are in!

steps.load_say: Row smoothly: a swarm is calm, as long as nobody bumps the hive.
steps.say: My bees! Not one sting for you? Then they like you. Take two crates of honey.

fact: When a hive gets too full, half the bees fly off with a new queen: a swarm.
